value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"A global household-products advertiser, one of the five biggest CPG ad spenders in the U.S., has instructed its media agencies to reallocate roughly $150 million of Q4 paid-search budget from Google Search to Amazon Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands, according to two people at agencies on the account and a third person briefed on the planning.","tickers":["AMZN","GOOGL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"advertiser Q4 paid-search budget reallocation from Google Search to Amazon Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands","period":"Q4","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"One agency source said the move follows an internal test in which the advertiser saw about 20% lower cost per incremental sale on Amazon during the Prime Big Deal Days window than on Google Shopping campaigns.","tickers":["AMZN","GOOGL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"cost per incremental sale on Amazon versus Google Shopping campaigns","period":"Prime Big Deal Days window","value":20,"unit":"pct","direction":"down","first_hand":false},{"quote":"A second source said part of the motive is anxiety about reduced click-through on commercial queries since the roll-out of expanded AI answers in search, but said the client's own data on this was \"inconclusive.\"","tickers":["GOOGL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"click-through on commercial queries after expanded AI answers in search","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"The third person said the reallocation is \"not final\" and could be scaled to $75-100 million if the Amazon results soften in the first two weeks.","tickers":["AMZN","GOOGL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"possible scaled-back advertiser budget reallocation","period":"Q4","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
